_instructions: VERIFIED ANSWERS: instant, offline, no Gemini. Each entry is answered exactly as written below.

To activate an entry: open the OFFICIAL page in your browser, then replace the TODO answer with 1-3 short spoken sentences that say only what that page says, and set source_url to that page's real address (must be on karnataka.gov.in or kar.nic.in).
Entries whose answer still starts with TODO are ignored. Write numbers in words for speech (for example: twelve hundred rupees).
Add questions people really ask (any wording) and spelling variants in 'keywords' (for example: gruha laxmi, griha lakshmi).
Check your work with:  python -m app.rag.kb_check   and test a question with:  python -m app.rag.kb_check "your question"
Do NOT copy amounts from news sites or blogs: sources disagree and amounts change. Use only the official page.

entries.title: Seva Sindhu portal
questions: What is Seva Sindhu?
Tell me about Seva Sindhu
What services can I get on Seva Sindhu?
Where can I apply for Karnataka government services online?
entries.answer: Seva Sindhu is the Karnataka Government's online portal for citizen services. You can apply for services from many government departments on the Seva Sindhu website, or ask at your nearest service centre.
entries._verify: Written from the Seva Sindhu page structure seen in the crawl (department services, service centres, track application). Confirm the wording against the page before the demo.

entries.title: Track application on Seva Sindhu
questions: How do I track my application on Seva Sindhu?
How can I check my application status?
Where can I see the status of my application?
entries.answer: On the Seva Sindhu website, choose the Track Your Application option. You can also ask at your nearest Seva Sindhu service centre.
